 Eagles-Steelers matchup in Week 11 flexed to earlier time slot 
 The Eagles-Steelers game for Week 11 has been flexed to an earlier time slot. 
 By Dave Zangaro • 
 Published 3 hours ago • 
 Updated 3 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 A change at QB couldn’t solve the big problems the Eagles are having up front. Hear from the Birds after another ugly loss to make it 7 in a row heading into the bye week. 
 The Eagles-Steelers game on Nov. 22 in Week 11 at the Linc has been flexed out of the 4:25 p.m. time slot to a 1 p.m. game at Lincoln Financial Field. The game is on CBS.
 This probably won’t be the last time the Eagles are flexed out of national games the rest of the season.
 The Eagles (2-7) have lost seven straight games since winning their first two and have finally reached their bye week after a loss to the Giants. The Steelers (6-2) will face the Bengals in Week 10 coming off their bye week.
 The Eagles-Steelers matchup was replaced by Jaguars (6-2) at Giants (5-2-1).
 Here’s a look at the Eagles’ remaining schedule as it stands:
 Week 10: BYE
Week 11: vs. Steelers on Sunday, Nov. 22 at 1 p.m.
Week 12: at Cowboys on Thursday, Nov. 26 at 4:30 p.m.
Week 13: at Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 4:05 p.m.
Week 14: vs. Colts on Sunday, Dec. 13 at 1 p.m.
Week 15: vs. Seahawks on Saturday, Dec. 19 at 5 p.m.
Week 16: vs. Texans on Thursday, Dec. 24 at 8:15 p.m.
Week 17: at 49ers on Sunday, Jan. 3 at 8:20 p.m.
Week 18: at Giants, TBD
